caption: A nightlight is plugged into a low wall socket, and it begins to glow.

sa.check: A nightlight and a wall socket set low on the wall.
The nightlight is pushed into the socket.
The socket is low, near the floor.
The nightlight is dark before it goes in.
The order is plug in, then glow.

pc.expect: The glow appears when the nightlight's prongs seat in the socket, and only then.
pc.fail: The nightlight is seated and stays dark; or it glows while still held away from the wall; or it lights up while lying on the floor.

pc.expect: Once in, the nightlight glows steadily for the rest of the clip and goes dark only if pulled out.
pc.fail: The glow fades out with the nightlight still in the socket; or switches on and off; or the nightlight glows on after being pulled out of the socket.

pc.expect: The glow lights the wall around the socket and the floor beneath, centred on the nightlight.
pc.fail: The nightlight glows while the wall around it stays as dark as before; or the wall brightens while the nightlight is dark; or the pool of light sits away from the nightlight.

pc.expect: Once seated the nightlight hangs on the socket with nothing else holding it and does not sag or fall.
pc.fail: The nightlight drops off the socket once the hand withdraws; or slides down the wall; or hovers a gap away from the socket.

pc.expect: One nightlight and one socket; the prongs enter the socket holes rather than the wall; fingers stay outside the wall.
pc.fail: The nightlight passes into the wall beside the socket; or a second nightlight appears; or the socket moves along the wall or vanishes; or the nightlight changes shape.

pc.expect: The nightlight's colour and shape, the wall and the skirting stay the same apart from the glow.
pc.fail: The nightlight changes colour rather than brightness; or the wall changes colour; or the socket changes design.
